newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares firm, Lek sought.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares firm, Lek sought.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index firmed one percent on Wednesday, pulled up by foreign demand that centred on pharmaceutical producer Lek.
"I believe shares will continue rising to the end of the year, with downward corrections from time to time, due to the strong foreign demand," said Alain Al Soufi of brokerage BPH.
He forecast the SBI would reach 1,650 points by the end of this month and over 2,000 points by year-end.
* The blue-chip SBI index rose 16.89 points to 1,557.56.
* Lek was most actively traded, up 1.12 percent to 36,000 tolars on volume of 2,597 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
